narrative.details:
In the northern areas of Winterspring, the Wildkin grow even more ferocious. We must continue our measures there.

Hunt the moontouched owlbeasts in Winterspring, and explore the area they inhabit.

This is dangerous ground, but I know that you will be able to handle the challenge. Return to me after you have slain 13 of the wildkin.
narrative.objectives: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts.
narrative.offerRewardText: I sense that you are enjoying your work. And I believe that we are onto something here.
narrative.requestItemsText: Don't tell me that you're too scared! Get going!
